sections.name: TemplateProvider
sections.title: Template provider
sections.what: The generator that uses no AI. It builds the output from the template in the request, checks it against the schema, and returns it with zero cost and zero tokens. It is used when no Gemini key is set and whenever generated text fails.
sections.why: The doc comment states it is the default without a key and the fallback for failed generation.
sections.watch_out: Its output is only as good as the template functions, and a template that breaks the schema will throw and can stop the fallback as well.

summary: A no-AI text generator that fills in pre-written templates, used when no model is configured or when a model call fails.
purpose: Make sure the product always returns a valid, safe result.
why: The doc comment says it is the default without a key and the fallback when generated text fails checks.
how: 1) Receive the request. 2) Run the request's template function on the input. 3) Check the result against the schema. 4) Return it with zero tokens and zero cost.
inputs: A generation request with its template function and input.
outputs: A checked result labelled as provider template and model template.
risks: Template text can be dull or wrong. If a template breaks the schema, the error is raised rather than hidden.
debug: If the template appears unexpectedly, check the logs for fallback reasons. If it throws, check what the template function returns for that task.
